idea-plugin.name: Tandem
idea-plugin.description:
A fast, native chat for Claude Code inside JetBrains IDEs.
Uses your own installed claude CLI and its sign-in; Tandem never reads your credentials. Edits go through the IDE, so undo, unsaved buffers and the native diff viewer all work.

Tandem is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC.
